display_name: Share of industries with non-falling prices in contractions, by concentration (Weston via Semmler), 1957-1970

triage.reason: Faithful reconstruction of Shaikh Figure 8.2 (Ch8, p.372). Cross-sectional: percent of industries with price increases or no decreases during each of three NBER contractions (1957-58, 1960-61, 1969-70), tabulated against CR4 concentration midpoints (20/50/80). From Weston, Lustgarten & Grottke (1974) as reported in Semmler (1984, p.95). The year column (1957/1960/1969) labels each contraction's cross-section; the real explanatory axis is the CR4 midpoint. Construction-relevant: Shaikh's exhibit that the sign of the price-concentration relation flips across contractions, refuting the administered-price prediction.

field_fixes.note: Source-table number ambiguity: Shaikh's text (Ch8 p.372) cites the Weston data as 'Semmler 1984, 95, table 3.2', while the chopped source_id and the digitized workbook (Appendix8_Semmler19843.3.xlsx) reference Semmler Table 3.3. Both are p.95; the book-narrative citation is table 3.2. Flagged for source-citation reconciliation; data values unaffected.
